title: feat(spec,analytics,lint,platform-objects,app-shell): a dataset measure can aggregate the time between two datetime fields of each record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9FC1KtovKr42Nv6HsVMzxW)_

Fixes #25778

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## Summary

A dataset measure can now aggregate the time between two `datetime` fields of each record. This is item 1 of the card. Item 2 (comparing against "now minus N days" where N lives on a related record) needs its own key, so it is split to #25808 as the order directed.

```ts
{ name: 'avg_hours_to_resolve', aggregate: 'avg', duration: { from: 'created_at', to: 'resolved_at', unit: 'hours' } }
```

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts`): `DatasetMeasureSchema` gains an optional `duration: { from, to, unit }` in place of `field`.
  - `from` and `to` are two bare column names of the dataset's own object.
  - `unit` is `seconds | minutes | hours | days`.
  - `aggregate` is `avg | min | max | sum`.
  - Refused at parse: a path, an expression or `*` in either column, the same column twice, any other unit, a counting or missing aggregate, and `field` / `derived` / `currency` beside it.
  - No expression language and no SQL enter the metadata (ADR-0021).
- **Analytics**:
  - The compile refuses a column not declared `datetime` with `400 DATASET_INVALID`.
  - `NativeSQLStrategy` computes `to - from` per row in double precision, per dialect: SQLite `julianday`, PostgreSQL `EXTRACT(EPOCH …)`, MySQL `TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND …) / 1.0E6`. It divides by the unit and wraps the result in the aggregate, or in the conditional aggregate when the measure has a scoped filter.
  - The draft preview computes the same value from the rows.
  - Nulls in either column are excluded. A `to` before its `from` counts as negative. Over a group with no record carrying both, `sum` answers `0` and the others `null`. The `0` is answered in the statement (`withEmptyGroupIdentity`, as for every other measure since #25953), so it sorts and pages as `0`.
- **Fail-closed**: the measure is deliberately absent from `cube.measures`. Every other path refuses it with `400 INVALID_FIELD`, naming the measure: a `granularity` bucket, a field-to-field filter, an object served through middleware or an external datasource, an unknown dialect, or a non-SQL driver. The field-level read gate judges both columns. `getMeta` lists the measure, and the `CUBE.MEASURE` spelling it lists is served too.
- **`os validate`**: new gating rule `measure-duration-field-type-refused`, at `datasets[N].measures[M].duration.from` / `.to`, with an `os explain` entry. `dataset-field-unknown` now covers both columns.
- **Console** (`ui/packages/app-shell`, in this repo since the objectui merge): the dataset inspector's base-object change now clears a duration measure with the other measures that name the old object's fields. Before this it was kept as if it were a plain row count, because it has no `field`.
- **Docs**: `data-modeling/analytics.mdx` gets a "Duration measures" section, and `deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` explains the rule. The liveness ledger drills `duration.{from,to,unit}`.

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-duration-measure.test.ts`: live on **SQLite and PostgreSQL**, with 7 cases on each driver (14/14 in total).
  - Covers values per unit and aggregate, nulls, a negative duration, an empty group, a measure filter, a derived measure, ordering with limit and offset (the all-NULL group pages as `0` on both drivers), and the cube door.
  - Rejections assert `code` + `status`: granularity, objectql-only, and date / number / text columns.
- `native-sql-duration-measure.test.ts` (23):
  - exact SQL per dialect, joins, temporal repair, the unknown-dialect decline, presentation, and the empty-group identity in the statement;
  - the preview evaluator;
  - service gates: no mint, the read gate (including a dimension sharing the measure's name), dry-run, preview, the unparsed-dataset door, compile guards, `getMeta`, the `CUBE.MEASURE` spelling, and the `$field` refusal.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/dataset-measure-duration.test.ts` (18), `packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-duration.test.ts` (12), and the ADR-0122 isomorphism pins.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/.../DatasetDefaultInspector.firstPickKeepsCount-12848.test.tsx`: the move fixture gains a duration measure, and the move clears it. The test fails with the predicate reverted.
- Full suites: service-analytics 4842 pass at `8821a8d4`, with 1 pre-existing failure ("the server is not on UTC", because the local PG runs on UTC). Lint 7310 pass. `tsc --noEmit` is clean for service-analytics, and the typecheck of lint, platform-objects and spec exits 0.
- Not measured locally: the `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check. `@object-ui/components` fails its own declaration build in this container at the main tip, in files this diff does not touch, so CI's `Type Check UI` is the reading for it. It is green on this head.

## Review

An independent full review ran on Fable. Round 1 was CHANGES REQUESTED, with 1 must-fix, 2 should-fix and 4 nits:
- the read-gate escape when a dimension shares the name;
- MySQL DECIMAL arithmetic;
- `getMeta` not listing the measure;
- the `CUBE.MEASURE` spelling;
- docs and comment nits.

All of them are applied except F6 (refusing a dimension/measure name collision at parse), which is a narrowing and so is out of scope. Three delta reviews followed, the last one after the ui/ merge, and each answered ACCEPT. The verdict record is in a comment on this PR.

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 2 → #25808.** It needs a now-anchored comparand with a `$field` offset read across a relationship, and the #5222 rulings keep SQL `$field` to the same table.
- **Not served off the native-SQL strategy.** The engine/ObjectQL aggregate has no node for a two-column operand, so a duration with a `granularity` bucket (a monthly trend) is refused loudly rather than answered. Follow-up candidate: an engine aggregation operand for durations.
- **The console inspector has no editor for `duration`.** A duration measure keeps its key through edits (`patchMeasure` spreads the row), and picking a field beside it is refused by the spec at save. Follow-up candidate: a from / to / unit editor in `DatasetDefaultInspector`.
- **No wire `unit` on result fields.** The unit lives on the dataset definition, and adding it to the result is a further protocol addition. Deliberately not done here.
- **MySQL is pinned as text only.** This package runs no live MySQL, so the docs claim live parity for SQLite and PostgreSQL only.
- **Pre-existing, measured: a filtered ordinary measure asked as `CUBE.MEASURE` drops its filter.** `query({ cube: 'sales', measures: ['sales.won_amount'] })` runs `SUM(amount)` while `['won_amount']` runs `SUM(CASE WHEN stage = $1 THEN amount END)`. That spelling is the one `getMeta` lists. The duration measure resolves its filter by the bare key, but ordinary measures do not. Filed as #25906.
- **An all-NULL sum group now sorts and pages as its `0` (#25907, fixed on main by #25953).** It used to fold to `0` only after the statement had ordered and paged it as NULL, at opposite ends on SQLite and PostgreSQL. Since the merge of main at `38050ced`, the duration measure takes the same in-statement identity, and the live ordering test includes that group: ascending, it pages b (-3599.25), c (0), a (91800) on both drivers.
- **Unmeasured: a dimension and a measure may share a name** (`DatasetSchema` checks uniqueness per list). Refusing that is a narrowing (review F6).
